question: Why does almost all of the world's primary gallium come from China?
answer: Because gallium is a by-product of alumina refining, and China refines more than half the world's alumina. Bauxite holds tens of grams of gallium per tonne; recovering it needs an extra circuit at the refinery, which China built and subsidised while Western plants shut theirs as prices fell. In 2024 China made 99%.
